clusters.explanation:
[OBSERVATION]
Autonomous Agent identified 3 connected orders totaling ₹8,609.67 linked via device_id, payment_fingerprint, promo_code.

[ANALYSIS]
Forensic Audit Score: 7.00. Graph analysis reveals an attribute-hopping chain across device_id, payment_fingerprint, promo_code. Individual pairs do not share all credentials, demonstrating deliberate evasion of single-attribute fraud filters. All accounts in this cluster are unverified and recently created.

[VERDICT]
FLAGGED. High-risk coordinated fraud ring pattern detected.

[RECOMMENDED ACTION]
Escalate cluster to senior fraud analyst queue for immediate pre-dispatch hold. Do not auto-cancel.

[OBSERVATION]
Autonomous Agent evaluated 2 orders linked via payment_fingerprint.

[ANALYSIS]
Forensic Audit Score: 2.50 (below risk threshold 4.0). Dampening factors applied due to low connection density.

[VERDICT]
CLEARED. Consistent with legitimate shared network activity (e.g. household/office).

[RECOMMENDED ACTION]
Clear cluster for normal order fulfillment. Maintain routine logging.

audit.honest_caveat: Precision/recall above are measured against DELIBERATELY INJECTED, KNOWN ring patterns in synthetic data. This validates that the detection MECHANISM works correctly on a known pattern — it does not, by itself, prove real-world generalization, which would require real (anonymized) order data this project has no access to.
